title: bonellia macrocarpa subsp. panamensis
intro: Bonellia macrocarpa subsp. panamensis, commonly known as Panamanian Bonellia, is a plant species belonging to the family Menispermaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bonellia macrocarpa subsp. panamensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight bacterial and fungal infections, and exhibit antioxidant activities, making it a potential treatment for several diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and make it a valuable resource in the field of ethnopharmacology.
